canonical_example.translation: Come on, don't get annoyed! It's just a manner of speaking.

canonical_example.text: Me dije que no volvería a empezar a fumar.
canonical_example.translation: I told myself that I wouldn't start smoking again.

unused_menu_senses.context: to express a thought to oneself

source_metadata.context: to express a thought to oneself

canonical_example.text: Me dije a mí misma, esto no parece estar bien.
canonical_example.translation: I said to myself, this doesn't feel right.

unused_menu_senses.context: to express a thought to oneself

source_metadata.context: to express a thought to oneself

canonical_example.text: Me sigo diciendo, ¿qué hubiera pasado si hubiera aceptado ese trabajo?
canonical_example.translation: I keep thinking to myself, what would have happened had I taken that job?

canonical_example.text: Para el alivio de su madre, Jorge no reprobó la clase.
canonical_example.translation: To his mother's relief, Jorge didn't fail the class.

canonical_example.text: Verte llegar sano y salvo fue un gran alivio.
canonical_example.translation: Seeing you arrive safe and sound was a huge relief.

canonical_example.text: Esta medicina alivia el dolor de cabeza.
canonical_example.translation: This medicine relieves headaches.

canonical_example.text: La morfina se usa para aliviar dolor extremo.
canonical_example.translation: Morphine is used to ease extreme pain.

canonical_example.text: Las palabras del doctor diciéndome que estaba sana me aliviaron mucho.
canonical_example.translation: I was soothed by the doctor's words telling me that I was healthy.

canonical_example.text: Es bueno llorar para aliviar tu pena.
canonical_example.translation: Crying is good to alleviate your sorrow.

canonical_example.text: Te ayudo con unas cosas para aliviar el peso de tu maleta.
canonical_example.translation: I'll help you with some things to lighten the weight of your suitcase.

canonical_example.text: El ladrón me alivió de mi nuevo celular.
canonical_example.translation: The thief relieved me of my new cell phone.

canonical_example.text: Justo después de tomar la medicina, el dolor empezó a aliviarse.
canonical_example.translation: Just after taking the medicine, the pain started to ease.

canonical_example.text: Mi hijo estuvo enfermo un par de días, pero ya se alivió.
canonical_example.translation: My son was sick for a couple of days, but he has gotten better.

canonical_example.text: Mi hermana se alivió el martes y ya está en casa con el bebé.
canonical_example.translation: My sister gave birth last Tuesday and she's already at home with the baby.

canonical_example.text: En este país hay sobra de ideas que no conducen a nada.
canonical_example.translation: In this country there's an excess of ideas that go nowhere.

canonical_example.text: La sobra de maíz hizo que bajara el precio del cereal.
canonical_example.translation: The surplus of corn brought the price of cereal down.

canonical_example.text: Si sobra comida después de la fiesta, la vamos a donar.
canonical_example.translation: If food is left over after the party, we'll donate it.

canonical_example.text: Sobran platos en la mesa. - Está bien; quita uno.
canonical_example.translation: There are too many plates on the table. - Ok; take one off.

canonical_example.text: Sobra comida chatarra en este carrito; mejor compramos más verduras.
canonical_example.translation: There is too much junk food in this cart; let's buy more vegetables instead.

additional_translations: too much, too well, in excess

canonical_example.text: Voy a comer las sobras de ayer.
canonical_example.translation: I'm going to eat the leftovers from yesterday.

canonical_example.text: Aproveché las sobras de la tela para hacerle un vestido a la muñeca de mi hija.
canonical_example.translation: I used the remnants of the cloth to make a dress for my daughter's doll.

canonical_example.text: Hay gente que sabe leer las sobras del café para adivinar el futuro.
canonical_example.translation: There are people who can read coffee dregs to predict the future.

canonical_example.text: Usted nos sobra en esta reunión, así que se puede retirar.
canonical_example.translation: You are not needed at this meeting, so you can leave.

canonical_example.text: Sobra agua en la olla para cocinar el arroz.
canonical_example.translation: There's more than enough water in the pot to cook the rice.

canonical_example.text: Me molesta mucho que me sobren.
canonical_example.translation: It really bothers me when people patronize me.

canonical_example.text: Los soldados usaban sus escudos para protegerse de flechazos.
canonical_example.translation: Soldiers used their shields to protect themselves from arrow shots.

canonical_example.text: El escudo de nuestra familia tiene tres leones.
canonical_example.translation: Our family's coat of arms features three lions.

canonical_example.text: Los portugueses cambiaron del escudo al euro en el año 1999.
canonical_example.translation: The Portuguese switched from the escudo to the euro in the year 1999.

canonical_example.text: Unos tipos sospechosos me siguieron hasta mi casa.
canonical_example.translation: Some suspicious guys followed me to my house.

canonical_example.text: A los alumnos les cuesta seguirme.
canonical_example.translation: Students find it hard to follow me.

canonical_example.text: Mucha gente decidió seguirme en Twitter después de mi publicación.
canonical_example.translation: Many people decided to follow me on Twitter after my post.

canonical_example.text: Nuestra compañía tiene oficinas en cuatro ciudades diferentes.
canonical_example.translation: Our company has offices in four different cities.

canonical_example.text: Vivo solo en las montañas, pero mi perro me hace compañía.
canonical_example.translation: I live alone in the mountains, but my dog keeps me company.

canonical_example.text: Mi papá dimitió de Microsoft para montar su propia compañía de software.
canonical_example.translation: My dad quit his job at Microsoft to set up his own software firm.

canonical_example.text: La Compañía Easy peleó en la Batalla de las Ardenas.
canonical_example.translation: Easy Company fought in the Battle of the Bulge.

canonical_example.text: Nuestra compañía teatral fue fundada en 1999 por un pequeño grupo de actores.
canonical_example.translation: Our theater company was founded in 1999 by a small group of actors.

canonical_example.text: Él está pagando la cuenta.
canonical_example.translation: He is paying the bill.

canonical_example.text: Me las pagarás por lo que me hiciste.
canonical_example.translation: You're going to pay for what you did to me.

canonical_example.text: Ya pagué yo.
canonical_example.translation: I already paid.

canonical_example.text: Pague y luego le serviremos la comida.
canonical_example.translation: Pay and then we'll serve you food.

canonical_example.text: Yo acabo de pagar mis deudas de la universidad.
canonical_example.translation: I just paid off my college loans.

canonical_example.text: Toma cinco años pagar el préstamo del carro.
canonical_example.translation: It takes five years to repay the loan on the car.

canonical_example.text: Mi primo me pagó el almuerzo.
canonical_example.translation: My cousin paid for my lunch.

canonical_example.text: Ella suele escuchar jazz de camino al trabajo.
canonical_example.translation: She usually listens to jazz on her way to work.

canonical_example.text: Hola, ¿me escuchas?
canonical_example.translation: Hello, can you hear me?

canonical_example.text: ¿Me escucharás si te digo que no desesperes?
canonical_example.translation: Will you listen to me if I tell you not to panic?

canonical_example.text: Nunca escucha.
canonical_example.translation: He never listens.

canonical_example.text: A veces me escucho y no sé lo que digo.
canonical_example.translation: Sometimes I listen to myself and I don't know what I'm saying.

canonical_example.text: Le encanta escucharse contando sus cuentos y haciendo a sus amigas reir.
canonical_example.translation: She loves hearing herself telling her stories and making her friends laugh.

canonical_example.text: ¿Pero tú te escuchas? ¿Sabes lo loco que suena eso?
canonical_example.translation: Listen to yourself! Do you know how wacky that sounds?

canonical_example.text: No sé cuándo paramos de escucharnos.
canonical_example.translation: I don't know when we stopped listening to each other.

unused_menu_senses.context: to pay attention to each other

source_metadata.context: to pay attention to each other

canonical_example.text: Parece que ya no nos escuchamos.
canonical_example.translation: It's as if we don't hear each other anymore.

unused_menu_senses.context: to pay attention to each other

canonical_example.text: Vimos un tiburón desde nuestro bote.
canonical_example.translation: We saw a shark from our boat.

canonical_example.text: El antiguo presidente era un tiburón, un verdadero depredador político.
canonical_example.translation: The former president was a shark, a real political predator.

canonical_example.text: Varios tiburones intentaron hacerse con el control de la compañía sin conseguirlo.
canonical_example.translation: Several raiders tried to take over the company without success.

canonical_example.text: La acusada intentó aclarar su motivación, pero para mí sigue siendo algo ilógico lo que hizo.
canonical_example.translation: The defendant tried to clarify her motives, but what she did still seems illogical to me.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quién me puede aclarar lo que pasó aquí anoche?
canonical_example.translation: Who can explain to me what happened here last night?

canonical_example.text: Solo quiero aclarar que no te quise ofender con ese comentario.
canonical_example.translation: I just want to make it clear that I didn't mean to offend you with that comment.

canonical_example.text: Me aseguró que se lo aclararía al jefe para que no me culparan a mí.
canonical_example.translation: He assured me he'd clear it up with the boss so I didn't get the blame.

canonical_example.text: Los niños salieron a jugar cuando el cielo aclaró.
canonical_example.translation: The children went out to play when the sky cleared.

canonical_example.text: Si aclaras la salsa pomodoro con un poco de vino blanco, el sabor se mejora mucho.
canonical_example.translation: If you thin tomato sauce with a little bit of white wine, the flavor is much better.

canonical_example.text: El servicio forestal va a aclarar 40 hectáreas del bosque para disminuir el riesgo de incendio.
canonical_example.translation: The forest service is going to clear 40 hectares of forest to reduce the risk of fire.

canonical_example.text: Después de lavar la ropa, hay que aclararla con agua tibia.
canonical_example.translation: After washing the clothes, you have to rinse them in warm water.

canonical_example.text: Se ve que fuiste a la playa, porque el sol te ha aclarado mucho el cabello.
canonical_example.translation: You can tell you went to the beach, because the sun has really lightened your hair.

canonical_example.text: ¿Qué usas para aclarar el cabello?
canonical_example.translation: What do you use to make your hair lighter?

canonical_example.text: Espero que la neblina aclare, porque quiero salir un rato en el velero.
canonical_example.translation: I hope the fog clears up, because I want to go out on my sailboat for a while.

canonical_example.text: Aclara antes de las 5 am en Oregon en el verano.
canonical_example.translation: It gets light before 5am in Oregon in the summer.

canonical_example.text: Cuando aclara, salgo a correr.
canonical_example.translation: When it dawns, I go out for a run.

canonical_example.text: Tu total y el mío no coinciden. Hay que revisar los gastos uno por uno para aclararnos.
canonical_example.translation: Your total and mine don't match. We need to review the expenses one by one to see if we can get ourselves straight.

canonical_example.text: Me llevó mucho tiempo aclararme.
canonical_example.translation: It took me a long time to wrap my head around it.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to wrap one's head around it

canonical_example.text: Hazme un diagrama a ver si así me aclaro.
canonical_example.translation: Draw me a diagram to see if that will help me get my head round it.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to get one's head round it

canonical_example.text: Parece que por fin te aclaraste con cómo usar la caja.
canonical_example.translation: It looks like you've finally got the hang of how to use the register.

canonical_example.text: ¿Te aclaraste el pelo, Nora?
canonical_example.translation: Did you lighten your hair, Nora?

canonical_example.text: ¿Ya se aclararon las cosas entre tu hermano y su novia?
canonical_example.translation: Have things between your brother and his girlfriend cleared up?

canonical_example.text: Se paró en frente del público y se aclaró antes de saludarles.
canonical_example.translation: He stood in front of the audience and cleared his throat before saying hello.

unused_menu_senses.context: to make one's voice more intelligible
